newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telecel stake to be priced 6,900-8,100 esc/shr.
newsitem.headline: Telecel stake to be priced 6,900-8,100 esc/shr.

text.p: The price in the flotation of a 35.6 percent stake in Portuguese mobile telephone operator Telecel due to take place in December will be between 6,900 and 8,100 escudos per share, the company said.
The sale of 7,645,000 shares will take place via a public offer to sell (OPV) and a domestic and international direct sale, it added.
The Telecel shares will be admitted to Lisbon bourse and the SEAQ in London.
Market sources had said that the operation would take place on December 9 and that the shares would be listed on Lisbon bourse a day later.
The main shareholder in Telecel is Telepri, a holding held jointly by the Espirito Santo and Amorim groups, which owns 75 percent of Telecel's capital.
